name: Class of 2014!
source:
During the spring of 2014, tragedy had struck the prestigious Miyamoto Advanced Academy with the death of its top student and our main character’s best friend - Reiko Nagamori.
Unable to cope with the trauma, he decides to flee to the United States and start anew - bringing his high school relationships to an unceremonious end.

Five years later, he is on his way home, where he is then faced with the ghosts of his past. With new information regarding Reiko’s death reaching the surface, our main character connects the dots and realises that things may not be as they seem.

By jumping back and forth in time, join our main character as he unveils the events that led up to the fateful event that changed his life.
Challenge the passing of time, discover the relationships he had made and fathom just how much things have changed, fall in love with the girls of Miyamoto Advanced Academy in both their past and present selves and figure out the secrets of the town of Izunagi.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
2014年春天，一场悲剧降临了声名显赫的宫本高等学园。学园的尖子生、也是主人公最好的朋友Reiko Nagamori离世了。
无法承受创伤的主人公决定逃往美国，重新开始，也让高中时期的人际关系草草画上了句号。

五年后，他踏上归乡之路，也不得不再次面对过去挥之不去的阴影。随着关于Reiko之死的新线索浮出水面，主人公逐渐将点滴信息串联起来，意识到事情或许并非表面所见的那样。

在过去与现在之间来回穿梭，与主人公一同揭开那件改变他一生的命运事件背后，究竟发生了什么。
对抗时间的流逝，重新认识他曾建立的关系，体会一切发生了多么深刻的变化。与过去和现在的宫本高等学园女孩们相恋，查明Izunagi小镇的秘密。

[摘自itch.io]
